messages:
ella: Quick heads-up — I published a new SDK compatibility matrix draft (v1.2) and enabled a lightweight "docs-heartbeat" CI job that will flag snippet/runtime mismatches. No immediate API removals, but we consolidated the streaming default across SDKs. Please skim and run the local check if you own examples.

ryan: Where's the matrix? link? Also should we add a changelog blurb?

ella: Link: https://rwd.internal/docs/sdk-compatibility/v1.2 (internal). Changelog lives under /docs/CHANGELOG.md — I'll add the one-liner.

maria: How do I run the heartbeat locally? Want to triage python snippets today.

ella: Run either: 
```
./scripts/docs_heartbeat.sh --check --sdk py
# or
python tools/docs_heartbeat.py --check-examples --sdk py
```
Docker image: rwd/docs-heartbeat:stable if you prefer containerized run.

alex: I'll own the JS side. Quick Q: the streaming-default consolidation — is that a hard break?

ella: Not a hard break. We keep backwards fallback for two releases (grace window). But we recommend updating examples to use explicit streaming flags.

ryan: I'll add a release-PR template note: "compatibility-matrix: v1.2; streaming-default consolidation; fallback retained for 2 releases."

docs-bot: nightly heartbeat queued (id: hb-20260415-03). Will post diffs if any mismatches detected.

maria: Ran the heartbeat locally — found 2 failing python snippets (embeddings example + long-poll sample). Opening PRs now.

alex: Fixed a small code-fence mismatch in js/chat/example.md — PR #5421. Also adding a tiny CI check to pin Node runtime used by docs.

ella: Thanks — owners for follow-ups: @maria (py examples), @alex (js examples), @ryan (release & changelog). I'll drop a short blurb in #announcements when the changelog + matrix are live. :thumbsup:

ryan: Added the one-liner to the SDK release PR template, and linked the matrix. (reaction :white_check_mark:)

ella: TL;DR for busy folks — matrix v1.2 published; docs-heartbeat enabled; streaming default consolidated (grace window = 2 releases). If you own snippets, run the heartbeat or watch the bot diffs.
